S: Pt presents for new pt exam. Gums bleed when brushing.
O: RBL ~9%; attachment loss 1 mm; probing depths up to 2 mm; bleeding at 32% of sites.
A: Findings as above.
P: Prophy + OHI. Re-eval gingiva at next recall.

S: Here for periodic oral eval. No pain or concerns.
O: CAL 1mm; bleeding at 16% of sites; PD max 4mm.
A: Plaque-induced gingivitis.
P: Prophy, OHI w/ emphasis on flossing. Recall 6 mo.

S: periodic oral eval. Pt reports no complaints.
O: attachment loss 0 mm; deepest pocket 1mm; no bleeding on probing.
A: Healthy gingiva.
P: Prophy. RTC 6 mo.

S: Pt presents for perio maintenance. Denies sensitivity.
O: BOP neg; deepest pocket 3mm.
A: Periodontium WNL.
P: Prophy. RTC 6 mo.

S: Here for 6 mo recall. No pain or concerns.
O: CAL 2mm; 5% horizontal bone loss on BWX; deepest pocket 3mm; bleeding at 27% of sites.
A: Stage I periodontitis.
P: Localized SRP, perio maint 4 mo.

S: Here for periodic oral eval. No pain or concerns.
O: probing depths up to 3 mm; attachment loss 1 mm; bleeding at 26% of sites.
A: See perio chart.
P: SRP 2 quads, re-eval 6 wk.

S: Here for 6 mo recall. Notes bleeding w/ flossing.
O: bleeding at 40% of sites; probing depths up to 5 mm; attachment loss 4 mm.
A: Moderate periodontitis.
P: 4 quad SRP, then perio maint q3-4 mo.

S: Here for recall exam. No pain or concerns.
O: RBL ~18%; CAL 4mm; BOP 20%; probing depths up to 5 mm.
A: Findings as above.
P: 4 quad SRP, then perio maint q3-4 mo.

S: Here for 6 mo recall. Gums bleed when brushing.
O: BOP 70%; PD max 6mm; attachment loss 6 mm; RBL ~54%.
A: Discussed w/ pt.
P: Full mouth SRP, perio consult.

S: Here for periodic oral eval. Notes bleeding w/ flossing.
O: 42% horizontal bone loss on BWX; attachment loss 6 mm; BOP 57%; PD max 7mm.
A: Discussed w/ pt.
P: SRP 4 quads, refer to periodontist.

S: Pt presents for 6 mo recall. Notes bleeding w/ flossing.
O: deepest pocket 8mm; CAL 8mm; bleeding at 50% of sites; 10 teeth previously lost to perio; RBL ~77%.
A: Findings as above.
P: Refer to periodontist for comprehensive tx plan.

S: recall exam. Pt reports gums bleed when brushing.
O: 7 teeth previously lost to perio; BOP 78%; probing depths up to 8 mm; 46% horizontal bone loss on BWX; CAL 10mm.
A: Stage IV periodontitis.
P: Refer to periodontist for comprehensive tx plan.
